prs.title: upnphttp: check malloc() when sending the 100 Continue response
prs.threat: malloc() unchecked while building the HTTP 100-Continue response to an untrusted client.
prs.plain: The HTTP server allocated the 100-Continue response buffer without checking malloc(). A NULL dereference on allocation failure. Checked and handled.

prs.title: netfilter_nft: keep the netlink socket in sync when a rule-cache refresh errors
prs.threat: A failed rule-cache refresh left the netlink socket out of sync, so later ops act on stale kernel state.
prs.plain: When an nftables rule-cache refresh errored, the netlink socket was left inconsistent, so later rule operations desynced from the kernel. Kept the socket in sync on the error path.

prs.title: miniupnpd/nftables: keep the remote host of IPv4 port mappings
prs.threat: The remote host of an IPv4 port mapping was dropped, widening a scoped mapping.
prs.plain: nftables IPv4 port mappings silently discarded the remote-host restriction, widening a mapping meant to be host-scoped. Preserved the remote host.

prs.title: miniupnpd/netfilter: create DNAT rules with the kernel's highest revision (fixes #837)
prs.threat: DNAT rules built with a fixed revision can silently mismatch the running kernel.
prs.plain: Port-mapping DNAT rules used a hardcoded netfilter revision; newer kernels expect the highest supported. A robustness fix so mappings install reliably (fixes #837).

prs.title: miniupnpd/netfilter: check calloc() results in iptables rule builders
prs.threat: calloc() results used without a NULL check in netfilter rule builders reachable from LAN UPnP requests.
prs.plain: Nine calloc() sites in the daemon's iptables rule construction used the result without checking NULL. Under memory pressure a request crashes the daemon. Hardened all sites.

prs.title: Harden store scoping for org-level secret and registry retrieval
prs.threat: A secret query matched org membership on org_id alone; a repo with OrgID 0 would match every repo-scoped secret.
prs.plain: Org-level secret/registry queries scoped on org_id without checking repo_id = 0. For a repo with OrgID 0 the clause matches every repo-scoped secret. Stated precisely: not exploitable on a normally-run instance, shipped as a defensive fix with isolation tests.

prs.title: Fix background_color handling across DeepSeek-VL and Janus image processors
prs.threat: Inconsistent background_color handling across DeepSeek-VL and Janus image processors skews pixel inputs.
prs.plain: The background_color padding value was handled inconsistently across the DeepSeek-VL and Janus multimodal image processors. Unified the handling.

prs.title: Fix features_only backward with grad checkpointing for in-place stem activations
prs.threat: features_only + grad checkpointing + an in-place stem activation corrupts the backward pass.
prs.plain: With features_only and gradient checkpointing, an in-place stem activation broke the recomputed backward. Fixed so checkpointed backward is correct.

prs.title: Fix GCViT global query mixing images within a batch
prs.threat: A global-query attention mixed features across images within a batch, so one sample's output depends on its batchmates.
prs.plain: GCViT's global query mixed information between images in the same batch: a prediction depended on whatever else was batched with it. A batch-invariance violation — same input, different output depending on neighbours — both a correctness and an information-flow bug.

prs.title: [Quantization] Flag layers narrower than group_size in the early group-size check
prs.threat: Layers narrower than group_size pass the early check, then quantize wrongly later.
prs.plain: The early group-size check did not flag layers narrower than group_size, so they slipped through to be quantized incorrectly. Flags them up front.

prs.title: Export unquantized FP8Linear layers in the export dtype, not fp32
prs.threat: Unquantized FP8 layers export as fp32, bloating and mis-typing the exported model.
prs.plain: Unquantized FP8Linear layers exported in fp32 rather than the export dtype, changing the served model. Export in the intended dtype.

prs.title: Preserve float32 in spectral features; add dtype= to frequency constructors
prs.threat: Spectral features silently promote float32 audio to float64, doubling memory and breaking dtype assumptions.
prs.plain: Spectral feature functions did not preserve float32; frequency constructors had no dtype=. Added dtype plumbing so audio pipelines stay in their chosen precision.

prs.title: Fix use-after-free and double-free in RemoveFilament
prs.threat: A code path frees an object then, lacking an early return, reads and frees it again.
prs.plain: Memory corruption in a config engine core. A missing return after a free let execution fall into a read of the freed pointer (use-after-free), then free it again (double-free). One-line fix, backported to two release branches.

prs.title: Fix memory leak and NULL-deref in shm_initialize
prs.threat: Shared-memory init leaks a buffer per call and dereferences an unchecked allocation.
prs.plain: shm_initialize() malloc'd a workspace, passed it to a read-only consumer, then overwrote the only pointer to it: a leak per init, plus a NULL deref on an unchecked allocation. Native C in a distributed-training path.

prs.title: Add neuron_from_equations(): generate a custom neuron class from state equations
prs.threat: (Feature addition: generate a neuron class from state equations.)
prs.plain: Added neuron_from_equations(): generate a custom neuron class from symbolic state equations. Feature addition.

prs.title: Add homeostasis: adaptive, time-varying threshold on SpikingNeuron
prs.threat: (Feature addition: adaptive, time-varying threshold.)
prs.plain: Added homeostasis: an adaptive, time-varying threshold on SpikingNeuron. Feature addition.

prs.title: Add SynapticDelay: per-channel axonal/synaptic delay with a learnable delay time
prs.threat: (Feature addition: per-channel learnable axonal/synaptic delay.)
prs.plain: Added SynapticDelay: per-channel axonal/synaptic delay with a learnable delay time. Capability accepted into the core — shows design range.

prs.title: vars: copy facts in set_host_facts() to stop cross-host fact aliasing (#87415)
prs.threat: set_host_facts() stored the caller's dict by reference, so run_once let one host see another host's facts.
prs.plain: With no cached facts, set_host_facts() stored the caller's dict itself, not a copy. Under run_once several hosts held the same object, so a later update made one host see another's facts. Copies the mapping.

prs.title: fix(geometry): render_gaussian2d pixel-coordinate linspace built at dtype
prs.threat: render_gaussian2d built its pixel-coordinate linspace at the wrong dtype, shifting the rendered peak.
prs.plain: render_gaussian2d's pixel-coordinate linspace was not built at the image dtype, shifting the Gaussian. Built it at dtype.

prs.title: fix(enhance): image_histogram2d bin centers built at image.dtype
prs.threat: image_histogram2d built bin centers at the wrong dtype, biasing the histogram.
prs.plain: image_histogram2d built its bin centers at a fixed dtype rather than the image's, biasing low-precision results. Built at image dtype.

prs.title: fix(feature): CoarseMatching training-mode gt-padding crash + dtype leak
prs.threat: CoarseMatching's training-mode ground-truth padding crashes, and leaks a dtype.
prs.plain: CoarseMatching crashed on its training-mode gt-padding path and leaked a dtype. Fixed both.

prs.title: Fix Signature.clone() sharing kwargs with the original signature
prs.threat: Signature.clone() passed kwargs by reference, so mutating a clone mutated the original signature.
prs.plain: Signature.clone() deep-copied options but passed kwargs by reference, so changing a clone changed the original. A silent task-definition corruption.

prs.title: Remove stale SAM3 decoder coordinate caches
prs.threat: A decoder kept stale coordinate caches across calls, so a later inference used a previous input's coordinates.
prs.plain: The SAM3 decoder kept stale coordinate caches between calls. Removed them so each inference uses its own coordinates — a state-leak-across-calls bug (net -60 lines).

prs.title: fix(augmentation): register fill_value/sigma as buffers, not plain attrs
prs.threat: fill_value/sigma as plain attrs are not moved/cast by .to(), breaking device/dtype moves.
prs.plain: Augmentation fill_value/sigma were plain attributes, not buffers, so module .to() silently skipped them. Registered as buffers.

prs.title: fix(geometry): bbox_to_mask position grid is exact at any image size
prs.threat: bbox_to_mask's position grid is inexact at some image sizes, mislabelling boundary pixels.
prs.plain: bbox_to_mask's coordinate grid was not exact at arbitrary image sizes, so boundary pixels fell on the wrong side. Made the grid exact at any size.

prs.title: fix(networks): AffineHead follows the module's dtype, not just device
prs.threat: A network head follows device but not dtype, so autocast produces wrong-dtype activations.
prs.plain: AffineHead followed the module device but not its dtype. Made it follow dtype too, so it behaves under autocast.

prs.title: fix(losses): BarlowTwinsLoss preserves float16/bfloat16 input dtype
prs.threat: A loss silently upcasts fp16/bf16 inputs, breaking mixed-precision numerics.
prs.plain: BarlowTwinsLoss did not preserve float16/bfloat16 input dtype. In mixed-precision training this silently changes numerics. Preserves the input dtype.

prs.title: fix(feature): register RenderingDeFMO's times as a buffer so .to() moves it
prs.threat: A tensor stored as a plain attribute is not moved by .to(device), so GPU inference reads a CPU tensor.
prs.plain: RenderingDeFMO kept its times tensor as a plain attribute, so .to(device) did not move it — a device-mismatch crash or silent CPU fallback. Registered it as a buffer.

prs.title: fix(geometry): bbox_to_mask3d intersects axis ranges for a full/overhanging-axis box
prs.threat: bbox_to_mask3d mis-handles a full/overhanging-axis box, producing a wrong 3D mask.
prs.plain: bbox_to_mask3d did not intersect axis ranges correctly for a box spanning or overhanging an axis, giving a wrong mask. Intersects the ranges.

prs.title: fix(geometry): finite gradients for solve_cubic at its acos boundary
prs.threat: solve_cubic's acos boundary yields NaN/Inf gradients, poisoning any training that backprops through it.
prs.plain: solve_cubic produced non-finite gradients at its acos boundary. The double-where guard keeps the backward pass finite at the singular point. Forward looks fine, gradients are NaN.

prs.title: Add RAFNode: resonate-and-fire neuron
prs.threat: (Feature addition: resonate-and-fire neuron model.)
prs.plain: Added RAFNode: a resonate-and-fire neuron. Feature accepted into the core.

prs.title: fix(augmentation): auto-augment ops preserve float16 / bfloat16 input dtype
prs.threat: Auto-augment ops silently upcast fp16/bf16 inputs during the data pipeline.
prs.plain: Auto-augment operations did not preserve float16/bfloat16, upcasting in the data pipeline. Preserves input dtype.

prs.title: Fix MSTDPLearner initialising eligibility without a dtype
prs.threat: An STDP learner initialises eligibility traces without a dtype, mismatching the network precision.
prs.plain: MSTDPLearner created its eligibility trace without a dtype, defaulting to float32 under a non-default-dtype network. Initialises with the right dtype.

prs.title: Move tensor reset values with the module in MemoryModule._apply
prs.threat: A stateful neuron's reset values were not moved by _apply, so .to() left them on the wrong device/dtype.
prs.plain: MemoryModule._apply did not move the neuron's reset values with the module, so .to() desynced state from parameters. Moved them too.

prs.title: Fix LeakyParallel silently ignoring a per-neuron beta; correct the reset=zero formula in Leaky
prs.threat: LeakyParallel silently ignored a per-neuron beta tensor and used a wrong reset=zero formula.
prs.plain: LeakyParallel silently ignored a per-neuron beta (length hidden_size) and had an incorrect reset=zero update. Fixed both — a silent wrong-result bug in a core neuron.
